message:
release: 0.2.122 -- the fixes the published 0.2.121 does not have

One minimal version carrying the two defects Codex found after 0.2.121 was closed, plus
what closing hypotheses 1b and 4 turned up.

The picker's empty-list line now depends on why the list is empty, the cards are drawn
against the same contract the refresh button already used, the untrue sentence about a
hidden window list is gone, the autostart migration checks its write before deleting
the entry it is replacing, a press on the toolbar is visible on screen, and the mouse
gate says what it swallowed.

Five artifacts changed: Client, Host, Setup, Updater, Viewer. ui/shell.html is byte for
byte what 0.2.121 published, so the hash pin in client_update_ui_test still resolves
against the signed manifest.

Gates before publishing: the manifest names all ten payload files, the product verifier
accepts the real document and refuses it with one byte changed, and the installer's
nine embedded resources hash to what the manifest says. After publishing: ten artifacts
fetched anonymously over https hash as signed, the server's own pair was read back and
re-verified through the product verifier, the 0.2.121 pair is backed up, three 0.2.121
artifacts were re-fetched and are unchanged, and the installer in dist compares equal
to the bytes the public URL serves.

Hypothesis 5 is reproduced but not fixed: the remedy is a present-path decision.
